title: Nourishing Crispy Irish Snap Peas Grill
description: A bright, crispy snap pea dish roasted on a robata grill, seasoned with Irish-inspired flavors and served from a kazan cauldron for a hearty brunch.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to high heat for 5 minutes.
Rinse the sugar snap peas and pat them dry with a clean towel.
Toss the peas with olive oil, sea salt, smoked paprika, and lemon zest until evenly coated.
Spread the peas in a single layer on the grill grates and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until crispy and lightly charred.
While the peas are grilling, toast almond slivers in a dry skillet until golden.
Remove the peas from the grill and transfer them to a heat‑proof kazan cauldron.
Sprinkle chopped mint and toasted almonds over the peas, stirring gently to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with an extra sprinkle of mint and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice if desired.
